why_this_slot.text: Best modeled placement for Danny Jansen is slot #3 (4.466 expected team runs/game).
Slots #3, #6, #2, #7, #1, #5, #8, #9, #4 are within 0.01 runs/game of each other — essentially equivalent under the model’s operational band.
Primary actual slot #8 ranks 7 of 9; estimated placement opportunity vs best is +0.002 R/G.
Slot #3 yields 4.45 expected PA/game vs 3.91 at primary slot #8. Batting order changes both game states and plate appearances.
